title: papaver pyrenaicum var. aurantiacum
intro: Papaver pyrenaicum var. aurantiacum, commonly known as the Pyrenean poppy or orange-flowered Pyrenean poppy, is a perennial plant species within the Papaver genus, characterized by its vibrant orange flowers and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and acting as an antiseptic to combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Papaver pyrenaicum var. aurantiacum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as protopine and berberine, and glycosides like papaverine, that exert analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant can also exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, further contributing to its therapeutic potential.
